'''2007 North Dakota State Championship Michael Raveling DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Michael Raveling]] at [[2007 North Dakota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Mike R.
* '''Deck name:''' Bounty
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
